meta.title: 分享几个简单的拍照姿势
meta.title_en: Share a Few Simple Photo Poses
meta.topic: 拍照教学 · 简单姿势

scenes.context: 不是这样站着，是双腿交叉，一只手摸耳朵，往左看。站姿拍照：双腿交叉+摸耳+往左看。语域：拍照教学，错对对比。
sentences: 不是这样站着，是双腿交叉。
Don't just stand there — cross your legs.
Rest one hand near your ear.
Look to the left for a livelier frame.
paraphrase: 双腿交叉 → cross the legs / one leg over the other
摸耳朵 → touch the ear / hand near the ear
scenes.speak: Don't just stand there — cross your legs. Rest one hand near your ear. Look to the left for a livelier frame.

scenes.context: 不是这样坐着，是把身体侧过来放在镜头的对角线上，手自然地搭在椅子上。坐姿拍照：身体侧放对角线。语域：拍照教学，错对对比。
sentences: 把身体侧过来，放在镜头的对角线上。
Turn your body along the frame's diagonal.
Let your hand rest naturally on the chair.
paraphrase: 对角线 → the diagonal / along the diagonal line
自然搭着 → rest naturally / hang loosely
scenes.speak: Don't just sit like that. Turn your body along the frame's diagonal. Let your hand rest naturally on the chair.

scenes.context: 不是这样拍半身，是双手放在后面，脸朝向有阳光的一面。半身照：双手背后+脸向光。语域：拍照教学，错对对比。
sentences: Don't shoot the half body this way.
Turn your face toward the sunlight.
paraphrase: 双手放后 → hands behind / arms behind the back
脸向光 → face the light / turn toward the sun
face the light · turn to sun
scenes.speak: Don't shoot the half body this way. Place both hands behind you. Turn your face toward the sunlight.

scenes.context: 三个简单姿势：交叉腿站姿、侧身坐姿、双手背后半身。都学会了吗？简单也出片。语域：拍照教学，收尾。
sentences: 交叉腿站姿、侧身坐姿、双手背后半身。
Crossed-leg standing, side-turned seated, hands-behind half.
None of the three poses is hard.
Simple poses can still deliver great shots.
paraphrase: 出片 → deliver great shots / turn out well
都不难 → none is hard / all easy
scenes.speak: Crossed-leg standing, side-turned seated, hands-behind half. None of the three poses is hard. Simple poses can still deliver great shots.

practice: Cross your legs, rest one hand near your ear, and look to the left.
Turn your body along the frame's diagonal.
Place both hands behind you and turn your face toward the sunlight.
Simple poses can still deliver great shots.
pitfalls: Don't just stand there — cross your legs.
Put the body on the opposite line.
Turn your body along the frame's diagonal.
「双手放在后面」用 both hands behind you。
Turn your face toward the sunlight.
「脸朝向阳光」用 toward the sunlight。
shifts: 用 cross your legs（交叉腿）、turn along the diagonal（侧身对角线）、hands behind（双手背后）
用 rest naturally（自然搭）、livelier frame（更灵动）、loose（松弛）
用 deliver great shots（出片）、turn out well（效果好）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：摸耳试→摸耳朵、往左看、镜头的对角线上、双手放在后面、脸朝向阳光、交叉腿、自然搭在椅子上、简单也出片等。
